DIAGNOSIS READY: Disseminated Gonococcal Arthritis (Gonococcal Septic Arthritis).

The clinical picture of fever, migratory-like polyarthralgia, tenosynovitis, and pathognomonic painless violaceous pustules on the wrists, combined with synovial fluid showing Gram-negative diplococci and a positive gonorrhea screen, is diagnostic.
